The annual exempt amount for capital gains tax is £3,000. This applies to gains on investments sold in a general investment account.

Gains above that amount on shares and funds are taxed at 18% or 24%, depending on your total taxable income. Losses can be set against gains in the same year, or carried forward if reported to HMRC. Income and gains within an ISA or pension are free of UK income tax and capital gains tax.

More detail is on the page at https://www.fernhillwealth.example/guides/tax/

**Discretionary management:** You agree an investment mandate and risk level with us. Our investment managers then make the day-to-day decisions within that mandate.
